The '''''Brazen''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] that served in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alistar Dadefra]].

==History==
The ''Brazen'' was dispatched to aid [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]] in the Elrood sector after the success of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] under [[Jacob Nive]] of raiding Imperial [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]]. At first, Dadefra was successful in not only decreasing the number of pirate raids, but also to stifle the rivalry between Captains [[Tanda Pryl]] and [[Akal Zed]] of ''[[Thunderflare]]'' and ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'' respectively.<ref name="OE" />

However, the ''Brazen'' was then [[Ambush near the Degan Gas Clouds|ambushed]] near the [[Degan Gas Clouds]] by the Khuiumin Survivors, who sought revenge for Dadefra's role in the [[Battle of Khuiumin]]. The pirates were defeated, but the ''Brazen'' suffered heavy damage: The concentrated attack destroyed the lower, portside [[Gemon-4 ion engine/Legends|Gemon-4]] ion engine and heavily damaged the center and port [[Destroyer-I ion engine/Legends|Destroyer-I ion engines]]. The resulting energy spikes threatened the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], but the [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] crew managed to divert most of the energy away, but they lost most of their lifes in the process. Although their efforts prevented a destruction of the ship, the overloads destroyed power feeds, [[Armor/Legends|armor plating]] up to two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] thick and buckled the superstructure.<ref name="OE" />

[[File:BrazenDerilyn.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Brazen'' after battle.]]
The ''Brazen'', despite severely damaged, made its way back to [[Derilyn]], where a large riot had broken out after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents had infiltrated the [[Arena of Games]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] put a complete lockdown on Derilyn and recruited every available technician for [[Operation: Elrood]]. All the ''Brazen''{{'s}} port [[Engine/Legends|engines]] had to be replaced, but the facilities of the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]] were too limited to conduct full repairs. The plan was to perform limited repairs on the Star Destroyer so she would be able to reach the Imperial [[Deepdock/Legends|deepdock]] in the [[Metharian Nebula/Legends|Metharian Nebula]].<ref name="OE" />

The same Rebel agents that caused the riot earlier, aided by the resistance group [[Friends of Paran]], infiltrated the space platform where the Star Destroyer was docked and planned to destroy it using improvised explosive devices planted at the now exposed engines. Additionally, Rebel agent [[Shondra Del]] contacted the Khuiumin Survivors, who threw all their remaining forces at the Star Destroyer. The operation was successful an the Brazen was destroyed, the platform severely damaged and Captain Dadefra killed in battle.<ref name="OE" />

[[Imperial HoloVision]] later reported at 36:4:16 that the destruction of the ''Brazen'' was probably caused by a worker error near the main reactor, while the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] conducted a thorough investigation on the incident. Moff Villis Andal and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Afren Hul]], humiliated by this defeat, were on the verge of losing their positions, although the Elrood sector remained an Imperial stronghold until the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="OE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Brazen'' was created for the [[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']] adventure supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]]. The infiltration of the Derilyn Space Defense Platform and the destruction of the Star Destroyer served as the climax for a three-parted campaign set in the Elrood sector, with Captain Dadefra performing a similar role like [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] in the movies.

The Brazen was pictured on the cover of the book using a modified [[:File:AvengerChaseFalcon-ST.jpg|stock image]] of the Star Destroyer [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Another image inside the book was drawn by [[Mike Vilardi]].
